per_ticket.description: Refund request — Gate 1 escalates (financial intent + money mention)
per_ticket.customer_message:
From: dave@example.com
Subject: I want my money back

I ordered the Pro plan last week and I was charged $200 but the features don't work. I want a refund immediately.
per_ticket.final_draft:
Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry the Pro plan features aren't working for you — that's frustrating, especially right after ordering.

I want to be upfront: I don't have our refund policy details in front of me right now, so I can't confirm the exact terms or timeline for your $200 charge. Rather than guess, I'd like to get this to the right person who can review your account and the charge directly.

In the meantime, could you let me know which features aren't working as expected? If it's something we can fix quickly, that may be the fastest path — but if you'd still prefer a refund, just say so and we'll take it from there.

Thanks for your patience,
ACME Support team

per_ticket.customer_message:
From: erin@example.com
Subject: This is UNACCEPTABLE

Your service has been DOWN for THREE DAYS and nobody has contacted me. This is completely unacceptable and I am furious! Fix this NOW or I'm cancelling everything.
per_ticket.final_draft:
Hi,

I'm really sorry — three days of downtime with no word from us is not the experience you should be having, and I understand why you're angry.

I don't want to give you an answer I can't stand behind, so I'm not going to guess at what's causing this or promise a fix timeline I haven't confirmed. What I can do right now is get this in front of the right people: I'm escalating your ticket as a priority and asking for a direct update on the outage and its status.

You'll hear back from us with a real update as soon as I have one. If you'd like, reply with the best number or email to reach you and I'll make sure the update goes there first.

Thank you for your patience — you shouldn't have had to chase us for this.

ACME Support team
